notes.title: Improved robber mechanics, smarter loan adjustments, and new expansion options
notes.content:

notes.title: Smarter loans, UI enhancements & interaction fixes | EA v0.5.0
notes.content:

[/b]

notes.title: New Update - Sell Items & 2 New Languages
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce the latest update packed with fantastic new features, enhancements, and critical fixes!
[/p][p]🛒 Sell or Return Purchased Items[/p][p]You can now sell back or return items you've previously purchased. Manage your assets smarter and keep your bank optimized!

🌍 New Languages Added[/p][p]We’ve introduced Hungarian 🇭🇺 and Polish 🇵🇱 language support! These were added thanks to community requests, if you'd like to see your language in the game, let us know![/p][p]Enjoy Bank Simulator in your preferred language and immerse yourself deeper into the gameplay. If you notice any translation issues, please report them in our Discord!

🔤 Improved Readability & Fonts[/p][p]Unreadable words have been fixed, and overall translations and fonts have received a thorough upgrade. Your in-game experience will now be clearer and smoother.

👨‍💼 Enhanced Teller Hiring[/p][p]You can now hire tellers at the same level as purchasing the Teller Office, with your first teller available at Level 10. Expand your team strategically and boost your bank’s efficiency!

💾 Save System & Performance Boost[/p][p]We’ve significantly improved game saving and overall performance. Say goodbye to frustrating crashes and enjoy a more stable gaming session.

[/p][p]💬 Love the update?[/p][p]🌟📝 Your reviews make a big difference![/p][p]🙏 If you’re enjoying the game, please leave a positive review on Steam, it helps us grow and brings more awesome updates to you faster. 💖🚀[/p][p][/p][p]💡 [b]Found bugs or have ideas?[/b]

👉 [url="https://discord.gg/wZ3ACd4h4A"]https://discord.gg/wZ3ACd4h4A[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting us![/p][p]Strong Bow Games Studio[/p]

notes.title: New Update – Smarter Customers & Verification!
notes.content:
[p]An update is now live in [b]Bank Simulator[/b], improving how you deal with customers and their behavior.
[/p][h2][b]🔧 What’s New:[/b][/h2][p]💬 [b]NPCs Talk
 [/b]Customers now speak using [b]chat messages[/b] or [b]subtitles[/b]. Expect greetings, complaints, jokes, funny messages or even suspicious excuses. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/e01f1f48ffb02651a682aea262a96c2c3c6ceff2.png"][/img][/p][p]📝 [b]Account Verification Required[/b]
Before accepting [b]withdrawals or deposits[/b], you should [b]verify the customer’s bank account[/b].
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/2e70d424194999cd30a127c1cf790a928f53574e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/5835ad65d2800f33ca75c6dc817962f92b8612bc.png"][/img][/p][p]💸 [b]Fake Money Can Appear[/b] Some customers may hand you fake cash, you should [b]check money[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/e1f5d0df3d6edc8ae3ce0355b7227d5c9a6ac4cc.png"][/img][/p][p]❗ [b]Overdraw Attempts[/b]
You should [b]make sure the customer has enough balance[/b] before giving them money.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/0c1d5761d9b575e46095c3b4c2782fe2527ec504.png"][/img][/p][p]📥 [b]Incorrect Deposits[/b]
You should [b]double-check the amount[/b] customers say vs. what they actually give you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/37b11f8e8fa402546aaca238fb77860242001940.png"][/img]
🏦 [b]Two Account Types[/b][/p][p]There are now [b]Personal[/b] and [b]Business[/b] accounts:[/p][p]• [i]Personal[/i]: Regular deposit and withdrawal amounts[/p][p]• [i]Business[/i]: Higher deposit and withdrawal amounts

This makes the deposit and withdrawal system [b]more realistic and adds deeper gameplay[/b] when handling different customer types.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]💡 [b]Found bugs or have ideas?[/b]
Join our Discord and share your thoughts:
[/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/wZ3ACd4h4A"]https://discord.gg/wZ3ACd4h4A[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Suggestions and bug fixing update v1
notes.content:
We’ve polished your experience with these key improvements:

🔹 Mouse Customization – Toggle "Invert Y/X Axis" in settings for your preferred aiming style.
🔹 Sharper Bond Data – Prices now show 2 decimal places for precise tracking.
🔹 Faster Loan Checks – Reduced delays when verifying loan details.
🔹 Bond Maturity Alerts – Get a clear notification when bonds are ready to cash in.
🔹 Daily Stats Fix – Corrected the 21st customer data display.
🔹 Smoother ID Checks – Interact with IDs more intuitively.
🔹 Big Screen Fix – End-day notifications now display properly on large monitors.
🔹 Cleaner Camera Motion – No more abrupt turns after closing mini games like id check or loan check

A Special Thanks ❤️
To everyone who shared feedback, we’re listening, and we’ll keep our promises. Your input shapes this game!

More exciting updates are coming… stay tuned! 🚀
